purpose: Release a changed tool only when feature-acceptance evidence is externally pinned and bound to the exact artifact bytes, AI intent assessment is bound to the same artifact and evidence digest, and source remains unmutated.

requirements.statement: Required feature acceptance needs a locked contract, external pin, PASS facts, SATISFIED AI assessment, and exact artifact/evidence identity binding.
Missing lock, missing pin, contract drift, target SHA mismatch, evidence digest mismatch, or unsatisfied intent must block release.
Building must not mutate source files.
